question: I'd like to know how many patients in the cohort have a positive anti-ribonuclear protein (RNP) result but no thrombosis. A positive RNP result means the anti-ribonuclear protein level is above 0, and no thrombosis means the thrombosis degree is 0. Please return just the number of such patients.
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID) FROM Examination AS T1 INNER JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID WHERE CAST(T2.RNP AS REAL) > 0 AND T1.Thrombosis = 0

expected.sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID) FROM Examination AS T1 INNER JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID WHERE CAST(T2.RNP AS REAL) > 0 AND T1.Thrombosis = 0
